_what: TRIP PRIORITY — PACK DATA, not engine logic. Which destination leads a lesson is a property of the PLAN, so it lives in a file. This is the same boundary rule as the phrase banks: adding or changing a subject is a FILE edit, never an engine edit.
_rule: A place Jordan has NAMED outranks a fare WATCHER. An abandoned trip's tracker drops below both. A watcher outlives the decision that created it, so it must never win by default.
_churn: Jordan, 2026-10-17: *"Lol sorry trip plans change a lot"* — recorded because it IS the design input. When the plan moves, edit THIS file. Nobody edits the engine for a calendar.
_default_rank_why: A place with no entry does not win by accident — it sits behind everything that was actually decided. An empty table makes the engine REFUSE rather than guess.

thailand.why: Jordan, in Gentech EDU, 2026-10-17: *"We both are planning a trip to Thailand and want to learn Thai."* His most recent word, and it names the destination outright.

bangkok.why: Same trip — the Bangkok leg (1-2 days, then Pattaya).

pattaya.why: Same trip — the Pattaya leg, and where the La Miniera villa is.

chiang mai.why: On the Thailand route list; the destination is named even though this leg is not yet chosen.

puerto plata.why: ABANDONED. The Amazon PTO blackout (Nov 28 - Dec 24) killed the November window (00-HQ/01-Travel/jordan-leave-plan-2026-10-15.md). The fare tracker is still on disk, which is the ONLY reason it kept winning rank 1 and the engine kept speeding to a trip nobody is taking.

sosua.why: Same abandoned DR trip, unaccented spelling — both spellings must rank alike or the answer depends on how a filename is typed.

_note_on_manila: The trip RECORD currently reads 'Manila & Pampanga — Dry Season 2027' (2027-02-12). It is deliberately ABSENT from this table: there is no Filipino pack, so a dialect cannot resolve for it, and the engine's resolver now skips a dialect it has no bank for rather than crashing or falling through to the next country. When a Filipino pack exists, this place gets an entry and a rank — one file, no engine edit.
_how_to_change_a_trip: 1. Edit the rank here (lower wins). 2. Say WHY in the same entry, with the source. 3. Nothing else. The engine re-reads this file on every run.
